settings.stop: each fit keeps the epoch (0 to 30; 0 is g's start) whose dataset-balanced mean, over the held-out questions with a new gold, of -mean log p over their new golds is lowest; ties go to the earlier epoch

index_time: m_s (each seed's mean neighbour displacement over the three families' union) and the per-family degrees depend on the node and the graph alone: rows of an index-time table, flagged as index-time graph aggregations; nothing comes from the question's scored rows
